Rotom Test Vectors
==================

All byte strings are written in memory order from X[0] to X[15],
following the state representation in the specification. The hexadecimal
strings below are not reversed when converted to the internal little-endian
word representations.

Rotom-128* and Rotom-256* denote the reduced-round versions of Rotom-128
and Rotom-256, respectively.


Round Tweakeys
--------------

T = 101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
K = 202122232425262728292a2b2c2d2e2f

Encryption and Decryption
-------------------------

For each input and variant, the ciphertext is defined as C = E_K(T, P).
Decryption under the same tweak and key must satisfy D_K(T, C) = P.

TV1:

T = 00000000000000000000000000000000
K = 00000000000000000000000000000000
C = 7a2ac99db527c727a0fd42c59cbcb1b4
